en: Follow staff around instruments, use only approved light, stay outside research areas, and protect the park's vegetation and wildlife. A research road is never an invitation to wander. Finish navigation and equipment checks before darkness, keep white light brief and directed downward, and never block gates, tracks, residences, or emergency access.

title.en: Confirm the El Leoncito access route

body.en: Contact CESCO, secure the night reservation, and confirm days, language, price, transport, weather, and whether separate park registration is required. Save the relevant page and contact details offline so a weak signal cannot turn uncertainty into trespass.

body.en: Leave Barreal early enough to check road and park conditions, orient in daylight, and keep warm layers and water immediately accessible. Mark the exact vehicle position and walking line while they are still easy to recognize, then identify the simplest safe retreat.
body.de: Verlasse Barreal früh genug für Straßen- und Parkprüfung, orientiere dich bei Tageslicht und halte warme Schichten sowie Wasser griffbereit. Markiere Fahrzeugposition und Gehlinie, solange sie gut erkennbar sind, und bestimme anschließend den einfachsten sicheren Rückzug.

body.en: Check in with staff, follow the visitor sequence, and use shared instruments without entering operational or research-only areas. Allow eyes to adapt, keep screens dim, and place equipment where another visitor, resident, animal, or vehicle will not encounter it unexpectedly.
body.de: Checke beim Team ein, folge dem Besucherablauf und nutze gemeinsame Instrumente ohne Betriebs- oder Forschungsbereiche zu betreten. Lass die Augen adaptieren, dimme Bildschirme und stelle Ausrüstung so auf, dass Besucher, Bewohner, Tiere oder Fahrzeuge nicht unerwartet darauf treffen.

body.en: Return by the planned route or remain at a separately booked legal camp; do not search for another observatory gate after the programme. Pack deliberately, count small items, restore the surface, and use the preselected route rather than adding an unresearched stop after midnight.
